title: Nosebleed
scenario: Nose will not stop bleeding, from dry air, a bump, or after injury.
steps: Sit upright and lean forward slightly so blood does not run down the throat.
Pinch the soft part of the nose, just below the bony bridge, for 10 to 15 minutes without letting go to check.
Breathe through your mouth. Spit out blood rather than swallowing it.
A cold pack on the bridge of the nose can help.
If bleeding continues after 30 minutes of pressure, seek medical care.
A nosebleed with clear fluid, or one that follows a serious head injury, can signal a skull fracture — call 911.
do_not: Do not lie down or tip the head backward.
Do not blow your nose for several hours after it stops.
Do not pack tissue deep into the nostril.
